name: Super Muesli Fruit & Nut
ingredients: Whole Grains 67.5% (Rolled Oats, Millet Flakes (Jowar, Ragi & Bajra), Brown Rice Flakes, Extruded Quinoa Flakes), Kakvi, Fruits 8.5% (Green Raisins, Black Raisins, Cranberry, Dates, & Apricot), Soy Protein Isolate, Nuts 4.5% (Almonds), Rice Bran Oil, Himalayan Pink Salt, Orange Oil and Natural Antioxidant (Rosemary Extract).
